paragraphs.text: How do you do, sir? All right, us being strangers one to another, but the Lord Jesus knows us both. Is that right? The reason I say that, the Angel of the Lord told me, “Get the people to believe you. And if they won’t believe you, then you’ll know the very secrets of the heart, and they’ll have to believe it then.” But you do believe me. And besides, the reason that you do believe me, you are a minister of the Gospel yourself. And you’re here for a good cause. You’re not sick. You’re in need, and you want an old fashion revival to break in your community. That’s what you’re praying for. Every one of us wants that. Let’s all stand for an old fashion revival. Almighty God, Who created the heavens and earth, I ask now that every demon power in this building will be broke, the power of Jesus Christ be made manifest. Lord, weak, but we are not defeated... Satan, I adjure thee in the Name of the Lord Jesus Christ, come out of the people. Stand up, you crippled people, out of the wheelchairs. Give Him praise, every one of you.
